newsitem.title: USA: K-III sees strength in education unit.
newsitem.headline: K-III sees strength in education unit.

text.p: K-III Communications Corp said Tuesday it expects to see continued strong performance in its education business.
"We expects to see continued strengthening throughout the rest of 1997 and are anticipating an excellent year in 1998," the company said in a statement.
For the second quarter, the unit recorded EBITDA -- earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization -- of $23.1 million, a 19.7 percent rise from a year ago.
The company also said it was "very optimistic" about its specialty media business, its largest segment, for the second half of this year.
Specialty media posted EBITDA of $42.7 million, up 24.5 percent from a year ago.
Specialty Media includes specialty consumer magazines and technical and trade magazines
The education unit includes classroom learning and business schools.
